sources.title: deAPI - One API for Open Source Generative AI Models
sources.snippet: deAPI is a unified API that gives you instant access to open-source AI models for text-to-image, text-to-speech, video transcription, and more. Instead of setting up GPUs yourself, requests are routed through a decentralized GPU cloud, making AI inference fast, scalable, and cost-efficient.

sources.title: Models - deAPI
sources.snippet: deAPI gives you a unified API across multiple open-source models running on a decentralized GPU cloud. We regularly expand the model lineup — new models, new capabilities, better performance — so your integration can always take advantage of the latest options.
